translations.web: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
translations.bsb: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
